import awkward as ak
from pocket_coffea.lib.processor import Processor

class DimuonAnalysisProcessor(Processor):
    """Minimal processor for dimuon analysis."""
    
    def apply_object_preselection(self, events):
        """Create MuonGood collection with pT > 15 GeV and |eta| < 2.4."""
        muons = events.Muon
        events["MuonGood"] = muons[(muons.pt > 15) & (ak.abs(muons.eta) < 2.4)]
        return events
    
    def count_objects(self, events):
        """Store number of selected muons per event."""
        events["nMuonGood"] = ak.num(events["MuonGood"])
        return events
